key_insight: Evidence-trained language models guided perovskite contact design, selecting a K analogue that outperformed the expert-preferred Na analogue.
engineering_relevance: Devices using the AI-selected contact achieved 27.05% power conversion efficiency and retained 96.74% of initial efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 training articles.
Train OpenPerov to connect experimental strategies, controls and observations with mechanistic interpretations.
Refine selected responses with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a self-assembled monolayer design.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted OpenPerov Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported dark thermal ageing result does not establish long-term stability under illumination or outdoor operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
